# Chunghwa Telecom September Revenue NT$24.40 Billion, Revenue, Operating Income, EBITDA and EPS All Hit Record Highs for September


2026/10/12


Chunghwa Telecom announced its unaudited consolidated operating results for September 2026. In September, the unaudited consolidated revenue was NT$24.40 billion. Operating income was NT$5.32 billion, and income before tax was NT$5.42 billion. Net income attributable to stockholders of the parent company was NT$4.44 billion and EBITDA reached NT$8.74 billion, while EPS was NT$0.57.


Revenue, operating income, EBITDA and EPS all reached record highs for the same period in September.


Chunghwa Telecom stated that its total revenue increased by 20.9% year over year in September, reaching a record high for the same period, driven by a one-off asset revitalization, robust growth in ICT businesses, and steady expansion in core telecom operations. In addition, Group’s September revenue growth was supported by the launch of the iPhone 18, which boosted handset and consumer electronics sales while driving growth in both mobile subscribers and ARPU. Meanwhile, robust AI demand resulted in the increasing high-end semiconductor sales at the Group’s subsidiaries, which further contributed to the Group’s consolidated revenue as well.


ICT revenue in September grew 24.9% year over year, driven by rising demand from the financial services and regulatory sectors for IDC, cloud, and cybersecurity infrastructure services, as well as the completion of factory construction projects for Taiwanese businesses by overseas subsidiaries. These results reflect growing enterprise demand for digital transformation and AI applications, supporting continued CHT Group growth.


Chunghwa Telecom continues to advance AI innovation through its CHT AI Factory platform and proprietary Danova Intelligent Operations and Maintenance Platform, helping enterprises accelerate AI adoption and enhance operational efficiency and resilience. These innovations earned two awards at Frost & Sullivan’s 2026 Best Practices Awards.


Moreover, telecom services continued to demonstrate steady growth amid stable market development. Mobile service revenue increased by 3.2% year over year, supported by continued 5G migration as well as stronger roaming demand. Fixed broadband revenue increased 3.0% year over year as subscribers using 300Mbps-or-higher packages grew 14.4% year over year, driven by ongoing digital transformation and AI adoption. Notably, subscriber number of adopting ultra-high speeds of 1Gbps or higher grew by over 60% compared to the same period last year, further demonstrating strong market demand for high-speed broadband.


As of September 2026, the accumulated unaudited consolidated revenue was NT$188.95 billion. Operating income was NT$41.74 billion and income before tax was NT$42.68 billion. Net income attributable to stockholders of the parent was NT$32.97 billion and EPS was NT$4.25. Revenue, operating income, income before tax, net income attributable to stockholders of the parent and EPS all exceeded guidance.

**About Chunghwa Telecom**


Chunghwa Telecom (TAIEX 2412, NYSE: CHT) (“Chunghwa” or “the Company”) is Taiwan’s largest integrated telecommunications services company that provides fixed-line, mobile, broadband, and internet services. The Company also provides information and communication technology services to corporate customers with its big data, information security, cloud computing and IDC capabilities, and is expanding its business into innovative technology services such as IoT, AI, etc. Chunghwa has been actively and continuously implemented environmental, social and governance (ESG) initiatives with the goal to achieve sustainability and has won numerous international and domestic awards and recognitions for its ESG commitments and best practices. For more information, please visit our website at www.cht.com.tw
